report.notes: R4-01: _BARE tld group widened from [^\W\d_]{2,24} to (?i:[a-z0-9]{2}--[\w-]{1,59})|[^\W\d_]{2,63}, and _is_domain returns True for any ACE ('xx--') label in host or tld before the _SENTENCE_WORDS/CJK exceptions. This fixes has_link_or_contact, verify, extractive, mask_links and build_surface. R4-02: gap_ok allows determiners, or one determiner plus at most 2 words from the fixed allow-list _PLAIN_MODIFIERS (long lengthy public formal official detailed). Any other skipped word fails closed, so the result no longer depends on states_quantity. _QUANTITY gained \w+ennial(ly), unanimous(ly), unanimity, fraction(s), trio(s), quartet(s), midnight, noon, gross as a second check only. Chose the allow-list over determiners-only because 3 existing tests (test_w1_d7_verbatim_numbers::test_claim_without_quantity_is_still_checked_not_quoted, test_w1_r2...::test_r2_02_excerpts_and_modifier_drops_are_still_the_brains_words, test_w1_r3...::test_r3_02_noun_phrase_modifiers_may_still_be_left_out) require 'after a long public consultation' to stay unquoted, and tests must not be weakened. Determiners-only needs owner approval to invert them. tests/web plus tests/assist: 2897 passed. New file on clean 462be42: 39 failed, 4 passed; the passes are the ordinary-text guard and the www2.refunds.xn--80asehdb case, which _OTHER's www rule already caught. The claim that real TLDs are letters-only or ACE-form comes from the RFCs; the IANA root zone list was not fetched. No graphify write commands run.
